def apply_edisp(self, npred):
        """Convolve map data with energy dispersion.

        Parameters
        ----------
        npred : `~gammapy.maps.Map`
            Predicted counts in true energy bins.

        Returns
        -------
        npred_reco : `~gammapy.maps.Map`
            Predicted counts in reconstructed energy bins.
        """
        # No energy dispersion -> return unchanged
        if self.edisp is None:
            return npred
        if self.model.apply_irf["edisp"]:
            return apply_edisp(npred, self.edisp)
        else:
            # If IRF not applied, return npred unchanged (no conversion)
            return npred
